test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 30 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully and decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. All birds are animals.

2. Some animals are men.

**Conclusions:**

1. No men is animal.

2. All animals are birds.

3. Some men are animals.

4. Some men are birds.
solution:
From the given statements, we draw the Venn diagram as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/368abca0450d6681b2babb894a42bd85a044d13bc52fe57387f0ec85f48a31c0.png] 

Thus, combining all the statements we get,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/78a944ff0034faddd246c86964d941c6d352187861055090f24ce77bf952d202.png] 

Next, we will check all the conclusions as:

1. No men is animal: Since some animal are men and so men are animal. This is not true.

2. All animals are birds: Since all birds are animals and so some animals are birds but not all. This is not true.

3. Some men are animals: Since some animals are men and so some men are animals. This is true. 

4. Some men are birds: Since all birds are animals and so some animals are men. So men are birds is not possible. This is not true.

 

Hence, only __**conclusion 3**__ is true.
